However, the evidence does not explicitly state that the transformer method was introduced *specifically* to address the 'gradient-vanishing' issue. Instead, it links the introduction of transformers to 'removing restrictions' (contextualized by the inability to understand the whole image due to local receptive fields) and addresses 'artefacts caused by incomplete projection data.' The gradient-vanishing issue is discussed in a separate paragraph regarding super-resolution techniques and a different reference (Ref. [35]), not directly as the motivation for the transformer-based SSTrans-3D method described in the same section.
